data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Lissie is derived from the name Elissaios, meaning 'God heals' or 'Liberator'. It is also linked to the Greek word 'lisso', meaning 'free'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lissie usually hope their child will grow to embody liberator, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: ליסי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ליסי נגזר מהמילה העברית 'אליס' שפירושה 'אלוהים הוא השוע שלי'. השם מופיע בשורשים עבריים וקשור לנושא ההצלה והישועה. השימוש בשם זה נמשך לאורך הדורות ומופיע בקרב קהילות יהודיות ונוצריות כאחד.

in_greek.name: Λίσση
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Λίσση προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἑβραϊκὴ λέξη 'אליס' ποὺ σημαίνει 'Θεός εἰς ἡ σωτηρία μου'. Στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόλο ποὺ δὲν ἀναφέρεται ἕνα συγκεκριμένο πρόσωπο μὲ αὐτὸ τὸ ὄνομα, ἡ ἔννοια τῆς σωτηρίας εἶναι θεμελιώδης στὸ χριστιανικὸ μήνυμα. Ἡ χρήση τοῦ ὀνόματος Λίσση ἦταν συνηθισμένη στὴν ἀρχαία Εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Lissie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lissie derivatur a voce hebrea 'אליס', quae significat 'Deus est salus mea'. In Scripturis Sacris, huiusmodi nomina quae salutem et auxilium Dei exprimunt, usitata sunt. In primitiva Ecclesia Christiana, appellatio Lissie ad thema redemptionis et protectionis divina pertinebat.

in_english.name: Lissie
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lissie originates from the Hebrew word 'אליס' (Alis), meaning 'God is my salvation'. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the concept of God as salvation is a recurring theme, especially in Psalms. Lissie, as a given name, symbolizes faith and divine protection. Historically, names with similar roots were used in Jewish and early Christian communities to express devotion and trust in God.

With the rise of the early Christian era, the name became popular among Christians as a sign of faith and belief in the healing powers of God. It was a name given to children born into Christian families as a reminder of God's blessings and miracles. Today, the name Lissie is used in many English-speaking countries and is often given to babies as a symbol of hope, healing, and freedom.
data.spiritual_significance: Lissie, as a name derived from the Greek word 'Elissaios', holds significant spiritual meaning for Christians. It is believed that the name represents the healing power of God and a reminder of the liberation and freedom that comes from a life rooted in faith. The name signifies the hope and belief that God has the power to heal physical, emotional, and spiritual wounds, and that with faith, one can be set free from the bonds of suffering and adversity. Additionally, stories and legends from various Christian communities often feature women named Lissie or Elissa, who embody the spiritual virtues of faith, hope, and healing.
